description: An INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION with no file-control-entry — ISO/IEC 1989:2002 12.3.1 brackets the FILE-CONTROL paragraph (`[ file-control-paragraph ] [ i-o-control-paragraph ]`) and 12.3.3.1 its entries (`FILE-CONTROL. [ file-control-entry ] ...`), as §2023:12.4.2 and §2023:12.4.4.2 do. X3.23-1985 prints `INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION. FILE-CONTROL. {file-control-entry} ... [ I-O-CONTROL. ... ]` (§1985:IV.6.2.3.1, §1985:VII.2.2.2): FILE-CONTROL is not bracketed and its entry is in braces, so a section that is written carries one entry at least. Parsed at every edition (fileControlParagraph? and fileControlClauseGroup*); introduction-gated post-bind by VersionConformancePass ParseArm.VisitInputOutputSection, which names both shapes (the section without FILE-CONTROL, the paragraph without an entry). kb/Work PB5167.
display: an INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION with no file-control-entry
vcr: 2002 relaxation: the FILE-CONTROL paragraph and its entries became optional (ISO/IEC 1989:2002 12.3.1, 12.3.3.1; kb/Work PB5167)
